task.title: P6-016: Build the per-card-row kebab (single-row move affordance)
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-016. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**The per-card-row kebab is unbuilt** — `design/wireframes.pen` → `Card Row > Row Kebab` (16 px lucide `ellipsis`) plus the `Column Header > Hdr Kebab Spacer` (16×1) that reserves its column. This is the spec's "per-row move (kebab / swipe / `m`)" affordance: a move for a single card row, distinct from the tree's collection-level menu and from the selection tray's batch move. Only `HeaderKebab` exists today (`my/collection.rs:860`) and it is collection-lifecycle only; `app-ui.md:1710` records the per-row move as unshipped.
